name: React Router Setup in Existing App
description: Adds client-side routing to an existing React app that uses state-based navigation, preserving all existing views while introducing URL-based routes and query param support.

parameters.name: routes
parameters.description: JSON array of route descriptors: [{path, component, description}]

parameters.name: existingNavPattern
parameters.description: Description of the current navigation pattern being replaced (e.g. useState with view enum)

parameters.name: queryParams
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of query params to parse and pass to components (e.g. tab, highlight)

parameters.name: deepLinkExample
parameters.description: Example of a deep-link that must work (e.g. /configure?tab=connections&highlight=uuid)

parameters.name: packageManager
parameters.description: Package manager to use for install command (npm/yarn/pnpm)
